Name: CoopBarnStatus
Author: Stitch1959
Description:
[b]OVERVIEW[/b]
A livestock panel for coops and barns. Facing a building from outside you get a summary; inside you get one card per animal plus the actions you actually need.

[b]WHAT YOU GET[/b]
• Simple panel, animal count, hay status, how many animals still need petting.
• Detailed panel, one card per animal with friendship, petted, fullness, produce and mood.
• Card contents, every field can be switched off, and one extra switch adds the raw friendship points next to the hearts.
• Hay counter, trough versus animals and silo versus capacity, with a separate low-hay warning.
• Pet all, pats every animal that has not been petted yet with the same numbers as patting by hand.
• Feed all, fills the trough from your silos.
• Sell, the vanilla sell path including the coloured particles and sounds, with optional confirmation and baby protection.
• Move, fades to the whole farm so you can pick the target building.

[b]INSTALL[/b]
1. Install the latest version of SMAPI.
2. Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
3. Run the game using SMAPI.

Generic Mod Config Menu is optional but recommended: without it you have to edit config.json by hand.

[b]HOW TO USE[/b]
The panel appears when you face a coop or barn from outside, and always while you are inside one.

• Q or gamepad Y, takes control of the panel.
• Up and down, the mouse wheel or the left stick, picks an animal.
• Left and right, picks Move or Sell. Enter or A runs it, Esc or B leaves.
• LB and RB, pet all animals or fill the trough from your silo.
• Mouse, click a card to select it, or click its Move or Sell button directly.
• Move screen, WASD, the arrow keys, the left stick or the D-pad pans the view, and the mouse also pans at the screen edge. Click a green building to confirm, Esc or right click cancels.

[b]SETTINGS[/b]
Install Generic Mod Config Menu to change any of these in game.

• Panel, enable it, show it while facing a building, use the detailed panel outside, set position and scale.
• Animal card contents, friendship, friendship value, petted, fullness, produce, mood, age.
• Hay, show the hay count, warn when the trough runs low.
• Hotkeys, panel toggle, action mode, pet all, feed from silo.
• Behaviour, enable the actions, ask before selling, block selling babies, console log.

[b]COMPATIBILITY[/b]
• Multiplayer, pet-all, feed-all, selling and moving only run on the host, but farmhands still see the panel.
• Menus, the panel hides itself while a menu is open and never receives clicks from menus.
• Toolbar, clicking the panel does not swing your tool or change the toolbar slot.
• Save data, no custom save data is stored, so you can remove the mod at any time.
• Languages, English, German, Spanish, French, Hungarian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Turkish and Simplified Chinese.

[b]REQUIREMENTS[/b]
• SMAPI 4.0.0 or later, tested with 4.5.2, game version 1.6.15.
• Generic Mod Config Menu is optional.
